productPreferences.title: Workspace preferences
productPreferences.description: Choose how TeslaSync prioritizes information when this browser opens. These presentation preferences never change permissions or backend authorization.

owner.label: Owner
owner.description: Keep the most useful everyday vehicle information close at hand.

fleetOperator.label: Fleet operator
fleetOperator.description: Prioritize active fleet operations and current vehicle state.

analyst.label: Analyst
analyst.description: Prioritize trends, reports, and historical analysis.

administrator.label: Administrator
administrator.description: Prioritize system administration and operational controls.

defaultVehicle.label: Default vehicle
defaultVehicle.hint: Choose the vehicle selected when TeslaSync opens.

defaultRange.label: Default analysis range
defaultRange.hint: Choose the time range used for new analysis views.

landing.label: Landing page
landing.hint: Choose the page shown when TeslaSync opens.

contextualHelp.label: Contextual help
contextualHelp.hint: Show helpful guidance in workspace controls.
